title: Bernama Media Kit 2026 — National News Agency
summary: Official 2026 media kit (24-page scanned deck; rate tables extracted).
description: Bernama Media Kit 2026 (24 pages, scanned images; rate tables extracted). National wire + portal + TV/radio extensions. Extracted rates cover press releases RM3k–24k, TV/radio spots RM220–5k, event coverage RM12k–50k, production RM3k–50k, and archives/images RM100–1,000.
